purpose: Measure whether a user can understand Mango behavior and find the next source entry without relying on a second AI explanation.

questions: What happens when it fails, and where is the next source file?

cases.recommendedFormat: 受控文字；先讲运行场景，再给最小流程
cases.prompt: 用一个具体场景解释 Resource runtime eventual worker：什么时候触发、为什么可以跳过、失败后会怎样。不要先给完整架构图。
expectedFacts: RUNTIME_EVENTUAL runs in a runtime background worker and does not block traffic.
A successful fingerprint includes current authority, source, module scope, and canonical declarations.
An unchanged successful fingerprint skips remote full registration.
A changed declaration or authority is submitted again; failure does not advance the successful fingerprint and is retried later.
sourceRefs: mango/mango-platform/mango-resource/README.md#10.1 Resource 级增量与运行时修改退避
forbiddenAssumptions: RUNTIME_EVENTUAL means bootstrap must finish before traffic

cases.recommendedFormat: 受控文字；用文件不存在场景解释错误边界
cases.prompt: 我看不懂 R.unwrap。请用“Service 调用文件 API 后文件不存在”的场景解释它解决什么问题、什么时候不应该用。
expectedFacts: R<T> is the common response envelope with code, success, msg, and data.
unwrap turns a data-required successful response into T.
Failure uses the response message first and the caller fallback message when successful data is absent.
An API that legitimately succeeds with empty data should keep the response instead of using unwrap.
forbiddenAssumptions: unwrap changes the HTTP response contract
caseQuestions: 在示例代码中，谁提供 OrderCode.ORDER_NOT_FOUND？
上游 msg 和 fallbackMessage 都存在时，先使用哪一个？
什么类型的接口成功但 data 为空时不适合 unwrap？

cases.recommendedFormat: 受控文字 + 关系图；保留租户上下文
cases.prompt: 请用一个员工离开部门但仍属于租户、以及彻底移出租户的场景，解释两种操作分别改变什么，哪些身份和权限会保留。
expectedFacts: Removing a current department relationship changes the organization relationship only.
Removing a tenant member keeps the global account and member identifiers but revokes current-tenant roles and department relationships.
Recovery only applies to members removed by the current feature and creates the selected organization relationship; old roles, posts, and other departments are not automatically restored.
Identity owns account and tenant-member facts; Org owns organization relationships; Authorization owns roles and permissions.
The operation is evaluated in the current tenant context and requires the member/org identifiers to belong to that context; permission and relationship checks are part of the real entry path.
forbiddenAssumptions: tenant removal deletes the global account
department removal automatically revokes every tenant role
caseQuestions: 只移出研发部时，账号、租户成员和角色分别发生什么？
移出租户 A 后，全局账号还在不在？
恢复时具体只重新建立哪一条关系？
请求中的 memberId、orgId 应该属于哪个租户上下文？
如果权限或关系校验失败，能否把操作当作成功？

cases.recommendedFormat: 受控文字；只问一个分类问题
cases.prompt: 我说‘workflow 失败了’，但没有说明是审批、CI/CD 还是普通业务状态机。先解释你缺少什么分类事实，不要直接调用 Mango 审批能力。
expectedFacts: The bare word workflow is ambiguous.
Mango approval guidance requires explicit signals such as @mango/workflow, mango-workflow-api, /workflow/ APIs, process definitions, or approve/reject/task actions.
CI/CD, PMO flow, generic state machines, and agent workflows are outside the Mango approval Skill.
Ask one short classification question only if the next action depends on it.
forbiddenAssumptions: load all workflow documentation before classification

cases.recommendedFormat: 文字 + 状态流图；标出不可逆边界
cases.prompt: 请用一个发布批次说明 plan、prepare、publish、status、repair 各自解决什么问题，以及为什么不能把它们当成一个‘发布命令’。
expectedFacts: The Mango release flow binds a plan to a source snapshot and release facts before preparing a candidate.
Prepare seals a candidate and its evidence; publish uses the sealed candidate rather than rebuilding a different artifact.
Status reads the publication state and repair handles an explicitly recoverable release state.
Release authorization and consumer verification are separate from ordinary Mango PR implementation.
forbiddenAssumptions: prepare and publish can silently rebuild different artifacts
ordinary business PR should use mango-release

cases.recommendedFormat: 角色关系图 + 文字版回退
cases.prompt: 请用登录后看到菜单这一条具体链路，解释 Identity、Auth、Authorization、Access、Admin Shell 各自负责什么，先不要介绍其它平台模块。
expectedFacts: Identity answers who the account and tenant member are.
Auth handles authentication and login context.
Authorization owns menus, buttons, API resources, roles, and permission facts.
Access and Admin Shell assemble the usable application entry and page surface.
The capability map provides the current reading order and troubleshooting entry.
forbiddenAssumptions: frontend menu visibility is the final authorization decision
Admin Shell owns business permission data

cases.recommendedFormat: 最小代码示例 + 上传到预览流程图
cases.prompt: 我要在合同表单上传附件，并在详情页预览。请说明组件、业务字段、后端权限/租户校验之间的关系，并给出最小用法。
expectedFacts: MUpload uploads and writes a file ID or attachment relationship.
The business form persists fileId or an attachment relation, not preview or download URLs.
FilePreviewPanel reads by file ID and displays preview/download actions.
The backend owns file status, access level, tenant, business ownership, and authorization checks.
Document preview may require mango-file-preview.

cases.recommendedFormat: 对比表；先给风险和模式结论
cases.prompt: 请解释 SIMPLE、STANDARD、FULL 和 M01-M16 的关系，用一个‘修改 PMO Skill’和一个‘简单 README 拼写修正’对比说明。
expectedFacts: Delivery mode controls process and document cost; M01-M16 are execution capabilities selected by observable facts.
L0/L1 normally maps to SIMPLE, L2 to STANDARD, and L3 to FULL.
Changing the PMO Skill or governance semantics is a governance-system change and should not be treated as a simple text edit.
A simple spelling-only README correction may use the lowest sufficient verification when it has no behavior or contract impact.
The final risk is max(requirement impact, solution risk).
forbiddenAssumptions: a small diff automatically means SIMPLE
